narr: A thunderstorm occurred over Powder River County, producing heavy rain amounts nearing 3 inches and hail up to 1.25 inches.
ev: Report of creeks flowing out of their banks. Fences were damaged and water tanks floated downstream. A few fields were flooded as well.
